svg.aria-label: Option (C) dendrogram over x1 to x5 (left to right): x1 and x2 merge at the lowest level, and x3 and x4 merge at the same lowest level; x5 then joins {x3, x4} at a middle level; finally {x1, x2} and {x3, x4, x5} merge at the top.
svg.title: Option (C) dendrogram over x1 to x5 (left to right): x1 and x2 merge at the lowest level, and x3 and x4 merge at the same lowest level; x5 then joins {x3, x4} at a middle level; finally {x1, x2} and {x3, x4, x5} merge at the top.
